title: 🔌 ABI / Bridge Matrix v0.1
text:
Here is the result of "fetch" for the Page with URL https://app.notion.com/p/3c44c57a590c81b3b3a0ddc38cf3b158 as of 2026-08-26T03:32:53.003Z: {"title":"ABI / Bridge Matrix v0.1"} {"type":"emoji","emoji":"🔌"} Current Cross-Boundary Reconciliation — 2026-08-26. Product-facing semantic authority以 为准；implementation-facing common contracts以 ICF-01 DataBridge、ICF-02 Platform Runtime、、、ICF-05为准。本页继续负责platform realization matrix；旧 Transaction-named DataBridge、旧“common Axiom C ABI完全 OPEN”只能作为历史状态，不能覆盖 current ICF。 Status: Current Direction — ABI / Bridge Realization Contract. 本页只定义“同一个 current Axiom semantic/implementation contract在不同平台通过什么 binding mechanism落地”，不重新设计 Semantic Schema、Operation Model、Runtime ownership或已由 ICF冻结到 Proposed Freeze层级的 common ABI shape。 # 0. Upstream authority - — Current Public Runtime Facade v0.2。 - — Current First-Batch Implementation Contract Gate。 - — Operation-only AxiomDataBridge current contract。 - — Axiom Platform Runtime / SurfaceMetrics common contract。 - — Current CanvasDocumentBinding contract。 - — Current PresentedFeedback implementation contract。 - — Document Close Barrier。 - — Arc compiler ABI仍为 Current Working / Draft，不提升 Frozen。 - — renderer/platform historical decision provenance；若与 current 06/07/ICF冲突，以 current authority为准。 # 1. Core rule: semantic contract != binding mechanism ```txt Axiom semantic contract │ ├── Web WASM export / JS wrapper ├── RN JSI/C++ binding ├── Android JNI bridge ├── Apple ObjC++ bridge └── stable native C ABI when required ``` Accepted principle: 这些 mechanism 不允许演化成不同的 API meaning。 同样，下面的名称表示逻辑合同，不意味着它们必须共享同一 compiler ABI： - Axiom Public Runtime Facade - AxiomDataBridge - Arc ↔ Axiom contract - PlatformSurfaceAdapter - TextInputAdapter - ExternalSurfaceAdapter - Platform Host internal API # 2. Contract ownership matrix
Contract Who calls it Owns Must not own Status
Axiom Public Runtime Facade Product Shell / Canvas binding Canvas lifecycle, document attachment intent, tools/commands, viewport, coarse state/events Snapshot/Operation persistence data plane, raw pointer hot path, Scene/Tile/GPU handles semantic authority = Facade v0.2；exact product-binding export shape仍按平台 realization推进
AxiomDataBridge Shared TS Data Runtime Document lifecycle, Snapshot, canonical Operation apply, local canonical Operation stream, commit/close fences Scene/Tile/Surface/Pointer/Product UI/server revision semantic + common C ABI = ICF-01 Proposed Freeze Candidate；platform binding realization仍需 target evidence
Arc → Axiom input Native Arc InputSource / Web adapter equivalent normalized PointerSampleBatch delivery Brush/prediction/Document semantics semantic boundary Accepted；exact compiler ABI OPEN
Axiom → Arc preview Axiom Ink/Preview pipeline transient preview packet/update, canonical-visible handoff semantics canonical Document ownership semantic contract Accepted；Arc compiler C ABI Current Direction
PlatformSurfaceAdapter Platform Host internal Axiom canonical target bind/resize/detach/recovery/present integration Arc preview ownership, Product UI, Storage responsibility Accepted；descriptor ABI OPEN
TextInputAdapter Platform Host / native editor layer IME/editor transient interaction bridge canonical RichText persistence semantics semantic boundary Accepted；exact adapter ABI OPEN
ExternalSurfaceAdapter Platform Host overlay/composition layer real WebView/native external surface lifecycle and placement realization semantic object ownership boundary Accepted；adapter API OPEN
Platform Host internal API Axiom SDK internals HostAttachment, SurfaceHostSet, frame/input/overlay orchestration public product contract, Storage/Sync semantics internal architecture Current Direction
# 3. Axiom Public Runtime Facade — platform realization Public Facade 是 interactive/control/presentation plane。产品层不应看到 HWND、ANativeWindow*、CALayer*、SkSurface*、swapchain 或 Arc surface descriptors。
Platform Product-facing layer Physical binding realization Notes Status
Web TypeScript facade / React Canvas host TS wrapper → WASM exports → C++ facade host mount 与 commands/state 走 facade；pointer hot path 使用独立 internal export semantic Accepted；export names OPEN
Windows RN RN Canvas Native Component + JS control API Native Component → C++ binding；JS control 可优先 JSI/C++ narrow facade Surface/Input 不逐事件经过 RN JS Current Direction
Android RN RN Fabric/native Canvas component Kotlin/Java native component → JNI for native host/surface lifecycle；control/data 可用 JSI/C++ narrow facade 不要把 JNI 与 JSI 强行统一成一个 mechanism Current Direction
Apple RN RN Native View / Fabric component Native View → ObjC++ platform adapter → C++；control/data 可用 JSI/C++ UIView/CALayer 不进入 public facade Current Direction
macOS reference native/reference host ObjC++ / C++ binding 产品 Shell 未冻结 OPEN/reference
# 4. AxiomDataBridge — platform realization ADR-013 已冻结 semantic surface： ```ts createDocument(documentId) restoreSnapshot(doc, bytes) createSnapshot(doc) applyOperations(doc, operations) subscribeLocalOperations(doc, sink) beginDocumentClose(doc) awaitLocalPublication(doc, fence) destroyDocument(doc) ``` 语义约束：process-local opaque DocumentHandle、Snapshot/Operation opaque bytes、batch仅做 ordered delivery/amortization、external apply no-echo、APPLIED-only CanonicalCommitStamp、async non-reentrant delivery、public contract不承诺 zero-copy。SemanticGeneration / server revision不进入 DataBridge surface。
Platform TS Runtime → Axiom Byte container Binding status
Web TS adapter → WASM DataBridge exports Uint8Array mapping Accepted；exact memory lease/copy strategy OPEN
Windows RN TS → preferred JSI/C++ narrow DataBridge Uint8Array / ArrayBuffer mapped to native bytes Current Direction
Android RN TS → preferred JSI/C++ DataBridge Uint8Array / ArrayBuffer Current Direction
Apple RN TS → preferred JSI/C++ DataBridge Uint8Array / ArrayBuffer Current Direction
Stable native FFI host versioned C ABI → same DataBridge semantics opaque byte span / owned buffer + explicit lifetime contract common C ABI shape = ICF-01 Proposed Freeze Candidate；WASM/JSI/platform wrapper realization/evidence仍未全部冻结
Important: JSI、WASM exports 与 C ABI 都只是 DataBridge realization，不是新的 DataBridge semantic versions。 # 5. High-frequency input bridge is a separate internal boundary 高频 input 不得复用 Public Runtime Facade 的普通 command/event queue，也不得经 AxiomDataBridge。 ## 5.1 Web ```txt PointerEvent / pointerrawupdate ↓ getCoalescedEvents() ↓ thin JS input adapter ↓ preallocated WASM memory / batch ↓ internal input export ↓ Axiom InputRouter / InkEngine ``` 这里不可完全删除 browser JS host boundary，但可以完全绕开 React state 与常规 Product command bridge。 ## 5.2 Android ```txt MotionEvent + history ↓ Native Canvas View ↓ normalize / batch ↓ JNI / native boundary ↓ PointerSampleBatch ↓ Axiom ``` JNI 负责 native event/surface integration 并不意味着 Shared Data Runtime 也必须用 JNI；DataBridge 可以使用 JSI/C++。 ## 5.3 Windows ```txt WM_POINTER / history candidate ↓ native Canvas host / Arc InputSource ↓ PointerSampleBatch ↓ Axiom C++ ``` 无需绕经 RN JS。 ## 5.4 Apple ```txt UITouch / Pencil / coalesced touches ↓ native View ↓ ObjC++ / C++ adapter ↓ PointerSampleBatch ↓ Axiom ``` 无需绕经 RN JS。 # 6. Arc ↔ Axiom internal contract Arc 不是 Product Shell SDK。Native build 中 Arc Input Acquisition 是 internal required path；Arc Preview Presentation 为 optional acceleration path。 逻辑方向： ```txt [Input] Arc / Platform InputSource ↓ PointerSampleBatch Axiom InputRouter / InkEngine [Preview] Axiom InkEngine ↓ Preview update / render packet Arc Preview Backend ↓ Arc-owned Preview Target [Handoff] Axiom canonical content presented ↓ canonical-visible acknowledgement/token Arc clear/release transient preview ``` Arc Preview C ABI 当前已经形成 versioned C ABI 草案：一个 bootstrap arc_get_api() + versioned function table、opaque handles、fixed-width types、no exceptions/STL across ABI、descriptor struct_size 扩展。但该 Compiler ABI 文档仍为 Draft for Review，因此 08 只把它列为 Current Direction，不升级为 Accepted。 # 7. PlatformSurfaceAdapter boundary PlatformSurfaceAdapter 是 Axiom canonical presentation 的 platform-private adapter，不是 Product API。 建议 contract responsibility： ```txt CanonicalHostSlot / host lease ↓ PlatformSurfaceAdapter ├── bind / attach ├── resize / SurfaceMetrics ├── visibility / rebind ├── suspend / resume ├── surface lost recovery ├── device lost recovery coordination └── present integration ↓ Axiom-owned Canonical Target ``` Accepted ownership: canonical target 始终属于 Axiom。Exact C struct/descriptors、GPU device sharing 与 present API 为 OPEN。 # 8. PlatformCanvasAdapter vs PlatformSurfaceAdapter 这两个名字不能混淆： ```txt PlatformCanvasAdapter = 整个 Canvas region 的 platform host adapter = native host lifecycle + slots + input hookup + overlay root + frame clock PlatformSurfaceAdapter = Axiom canonical renderer 的 platform surface binding = 只消费 CanonicalHostSlot ``` PlatformCanvasAdapter 可以看见 CanonicalHostSlot / PreviewHostSlot / OverlayHostRoot；PlatformSurfaceAdapter 不负责 Arc Preview 或 ExternalSurface。 # 9. TextInputAdapter contract category 上游已经 Accepted：RichText/Text semantic state 属于 Axiom；真实 IME/editor 由平台 adapter/overlay 承担；composition intermediate state 不进入 Document。 当前 08 只冻结方向，不冻结 exact ABI： ```txt Axiom TextEditSession ↔ TextInputAdapter ↔ Browser DOM / Windows IME / Android IME / UIKit-AppKit editor ``` 最少需要表达的 semantic direction： - Axiom → platform：editing active/inactive、editor placement/geometry、当前 committed text/edit context 所需的 UI state； - platform → Axiom：composition update、commit、cancel 与 platform text editing actions； - composition intermediate state 保持 transient；commit 才进入 canonical Operation。 以上 method names、buffer formats、selection/geometry payload 仍为 OPEN，不得在本页假装已冻结。 # 10. ExternalSurfaceAdapter contract category Accepted semantic boundary：Axiom 持有 ExternalSurface object 的 identity / geometry / clip / z-order / lifecycle intent；Platform Host/adapter 持有真实 WebView/iframe/native surface。 08 中建议把 platform realization 统一归类为 ExternalSurfaceAdapter，但 exact API 为 OPEN： ```txt Axiom semantic object / viewport state ↓ Platform Host OverlayCoordinator ↓ ExternalSurfaceAdapter ↓ iframe / WebView / WKWebView / native external visual ``` 它不属于 Axiom Renderer backend，也不允许真实 WebView handle 写入 Semantic Document。 # 11. Platform Host internal API Platform Host 是 Axiom SDK internal orchestration，不是独立 public SDK。 内部 contract 应覆盖： - Canvas host attachment / detach； - SurfaceHostSet production； - SurfaceMetrics / viewport host metrics； - frame clock/VSync hookup； - input host hookup； - overlay/native editor root； - foreground/background/suspend/resume； - surface/device loss notification； - optional Arc Preview slot； - final composition relationship。 具体 C++ class 名称、class layout、thread count 与 OS object descriptor 均 OPEN。Product Shell 不允许直接依赖这些 internal APIs。 # 12. Cross-language callback rules 从现有 Public Facade / ADR-013 可冻结以下通用语义： - C++ exception 不跨 WASM/JSI/C ABI boundary； - JS/RN callback 不允许从 Input/Render thread 同步 re-enter； - canonical local Operation stream只来自 AxiomDataBridge；legacy Transaction naming仅作历史 provenance； - high-frequency pointer / preview frame 不成为 Product Shell event； - callbacks 可以 coalesce 的前提是不会破坏 semantic correctness； - async DataBridge input bytes 在调用完成前视为 immutable；output bytes 必须拥有安全 lifetime。 # 13. Stable C ABI mechanical rules — Integrated by ICF 本节原本是 Proposal；当前其通用机械规则已被 Implementation Contract Freeze + ICF-00 吸收为 First-Batch Proposed Freeze Candidate。以下内容保留作为 08 realization summary，不再表示“是否采用 stable C ABI”仍未决定： - 一个 versioned bootstrap/function table 或等价 version negotiation； - opaque handles； - fixed-width integers，不在 ABI 用 size_t / compiler bool / implicit enum size； - extensible descriptor 首字段 struct_size； - no STL / exception / RTTI / virtual class across ABI； - ownership 通过 handle / explicit callback 表达； - C ABI 只作为 process-local compiler contract，不等同于 Snapshot/AXTP/wire format。 # 14. Superseded / rejected bridge interpretations 以下不得重新出现： - 所有平台必须使用同一种 bridge 技术； - Product Shell 直接持有 HWND/ANativeWindow/CAMetalLayer/SkSurface； - pointer samples 通过 React/RN state 或普通 JS command bridge； - Snapshot/Operation persistence data plane同时在 Runtime Facade 与 DataBridge各发一份； - external/replay apply 回显到 local Outbox stream； - Web 强行删除 JS host boundary； - Arc 与 Axiom 共享同一个 presentable backbuffer ownership； - DataBridge 为了 native 性能暴露 C++ object graph 或 JSON mirror。 # 15. OPEN ABI decisions - Axiom Public Runtime Facade exact WASM export / JSI wrapper realization； - AxiomDataBridge exact JSI/WASM buffer lease/copy realization与真实 target compile evidence； - current ICF stable C ABI 的 target-specific adapter materialization / WASM32 layout golden； - Arc compiler C ABI final acceptance / numeric versioning； - Arc platform surface binding exact compiler ABI仍为 Working； - future public ABI extensions not covered by First Batch； - PlatformSurfaceAdapter descriptors and GPU device/context sharing； - TextInputAdapter exact methods/payload/threading； - ExternalSurfaceAdapter exact lifecycle/snapshot API； - Windows Screen Annotation 是否同 process；若跨 process 需要另行 IPC contract； - per-platform error/result mapping 与 diagnostics payload。
